title: Music and film
description: Name the things on a stage, and talk about what you watch and hear.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for the arts
grammarNote: These nouns are ordinary ones, and the ones that name a person take el or la like any other noun.

explanation.summary: Music and film have their own small set of nouns, and they are the words a learner needs to talk about what they watch and listen to.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El teatro, el concierto, el piano, el violín, el actor, el público y el programa are masculine. La guitarra, el baile y la actriz are feminine. El programa is the programme, and el público is the audience.

sections.heading: Where the things are
sections.body: You already know how to say where something is. El concierto está en el teatro, the concert is at the theatre. La guitarra está en la caja, the guitar is in the case. Es and está work as usual: el baile es bonito, the dance is beautiful, and el teatro está lleno, the theatre is full.

examples.es: el concierto está en el teatro
examples.en: the concert is at the theatre

examples.es: la guitarra es de mi hermano

items.note: Masculine: el violín. The accent marks the stress.
Masculine: el público. The accent marks the stress.

drills.meaning: the concert is at the theatre
